findings.design: ReVerifyDiffPanel renders as a centered modal overlay (position: absolute, inset 0, rgba(10,15,30,0.6) backdrop, z-index 20) with its own header/diff-table/footer sections and a box-shadow, blocking interaction with the rest of the screen while re-verifying a cert.
findings.app: The diff is rendered as an ordinary inline section appended at the bottom of the same scrollable page (`v-if="diff"` block), with no backdrop, no centering, no overlay/blocking behavior — the tables above remain fully interactive underneath it.

findings.design: Error state shows an alert icon plus inline 'Retry' button (border, poor-color text) next to 'Could not load certifications. Please try again.'
findings.app: Error state renders only plain red text 'Could not load certifications. Please try again.' with no icon and no retry affordance — the user has no way to re-trigger the query from the UI.

findings.design: While submitting, the 'Accept all & re-verify' button shows a spinning loader plus its label changes to 'Re-verifying…', in addition to being disabled.
findings.app: Button only gets `disabled` + `opacity-50`; the label always reads 'Accept all & re-verify' and there is no spinner during submission.

findings.element: Existing certifications section label + active count
findings.design: SectionLabel renders an uppercase, letter-spaced caption 'EXISTING CERTIFICATIONS' with a muted count badge (e.g. '3 active') next to it.
findings.app: Second heading duplicates the page title verbatim ('Certifications' — identical text to the h1 above it) as a plain h2, with no 'Existing' qualifier and no active-count badge.

findings.design: Header includes a descriptive subtitle: 'Manage certifications and keep their metadata verified against source.' beneath the title.
findings.app: Only the h1 'Certifications' is rendered; no subtitle text.

findings.element: Table shell (card chrome around Existing/Due tables)
findings.design: TableShell wraps each table in a bordered, rounded (rXl) surface card visually distinct from the page background, with an elevated-background header row.
findings.app: Plain HTML `<table>` with only a bottom border under the header row — no card container, background, border, or corner radius.

findings.design: Exam code (e.g. 'SAA-C03') is rendered as a monospaced pill with its own background, border, and radius (CodeChip).
findings.app: Code is rendered as plain text in a `<td>` with no monospace font or pill/chip styling.

findings.design: Loading state shows a spinning ring indicator next to 'Loading certifications…'.
findings.app: Loading state renders only the text 'Loading certifications…' with no spinner.

findings.design: Primary action button includes a leading '+' SVG icon alongside the label.
findings.app: NuxtLink renders only the text 'New certification', no icon.

findings.design: Sidebar + content fill the full artboard width edge-to-edge (no outer max-width constraint on the admin shell itself); content region scrolls independently of a fixed header bar.
findings.app: AdminConsole wraps sidebar+content in `mx-auto max-w-7xl ... px-4 py-8`, centering the whole console with side gutters on wide viewports, and there is no distinct sticky/bordered header bar — the title row scrolls with the rest of the content.

findings.design: A re-verification failure is shown inside the diff panel's own footer, scoped to that modal, alongside the Cancel/Accept actions.
findings.app: `reverifyError` is rendered as a standalone paragraph between the Due table and the diff section, outside/above the diff block rather than inside its footer.
